exposure: diagnosis of HIP at an earlier trimester (<24 weeks)
fasting and 2-h plasma glucose >100 (>5.6 mmol/L) and >195 mg/dL (>10.9 mmol/L)
need for insulin treatment during pregnancy
cohort: 178 women diagnosed with HIP after the first trimester, attending tertiary care hospitals between December 2018 and March 2020
finding: The incidence of postpartum glucose intolerance in women with HIP is high, particularly among those with obesity, early diagnosis of HIP, signs of insulin resistance, and who required insulin treatment during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was reported as a delivery outcome (71.3% of participants) but was not examined as a risk factor for postpartum diabetes in women with hyperglycemia in pregnancy.
